prompts.bottle-glass.png: Create an original production game sprite for a premium mobile liquid sorting puzzle. ONE EMPTY clear glass bottle, front orthographic view, isolated on true transparent background, no background color and no ground shadow. Tall slim straight-sided cylindrical bottle with gently rounded shoulders, short narrow open neck and elliptical glass lip; body is 3 times wider than neck? NO: neck width 55 percent body width. Overall height 3.2 times body width. Perfect symmetric silhouette. Bottle occupies exactly central 76% width and 94% height of a portrait image. Soft pale cyan glass edges, natural translucent specular highlights on upper right shoulder and slim left/right edge, subtle blue-green bottom rim. The entire hollow central body MUST be transparent alpha so colored liquid rendered behind it shows through unchanged. No liquid, no cork, no label, no text, no marks. Style polished semi-realistic casual puzzle 3D render, not cartoon outline. Neutral studio light. Crisp smooth contours, generous transparent margins. This is a reusable foreground glass overlay game asset.
